title.zh-CN: 自动喂食器怎么选？看这四点就够了
title.en: How to Choose an Automatic Feeder: Four Things That Matter

summary.zh-CN: 粮桶容量、出粮精度、防卡粮和断电保护。
summary.en: Hopper size, portion accuracy, anti-jam design and power backup.

content.zh-CN:
挑喂食器先看家里几只宠物、每次出门多久。

一、粮桶容量

单猫家庭 3–5L 足够。

二、出粮精度

每份克数越小越好控制体重。
content.en:
Start with how many pets you have and how long you are usually away.

1. Hopper size

3–5L is plenty for a single cat.

2. Portion accuracy

Smaller portions make weight control easier.

title.zh-CN: 设备连不上 Wi-Fi 怎么办？
title.en: My device will not connect to Wi-Fi

content.zh-CN: 设备只支持 2.4GHz 网络。请确认路由器开启了 2.4GHz，并让手机先连上它再配网。
content.en: The device only works on 2.4GHz networks. Make sure your router has 2.4GHz enabled and connect your phone to it before pairing.
